profit_quality.assessment: 2024 reported loss is distorted by HK$90m non-current asset impairment, while operating cash flow remained positive. Three-year operating free cash flow median is HK$48.519m, but beer revenue declined in 2024, Hong Kong beer segment adjusted EBIT was negative, a single customer is large, and part of the cash/profit chain sits in Mainland China. Main denominator therefore applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Use 2022-2024 operating free cash flow after capex rather than 2024 reported net loss alone.
Exclude the non-cash HK$90m non-current asset impairment from recurring cash profit, but reflect it through profit haircut because it signals asset return pressure.
Treat bank interest as funds-asset return rather than core beer profit; no separate uplift is added beyond observed cash flow.
Use recent capex cash outflow as maintenance/reinvestment proxy because annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating CFO/free cash flow: 2022 HK$37.159m/HK$21.074m, 2023 HK$88.707m/HK$64.203m, 2024 HK$67.697m/HK$48.519m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 0.75 reflects positive multi-year cash conversion but discounts 2024 impairment, revenue decline, negative Hong Kong adjusted EBIT and cash remittance uncertainty.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Cash flow is stronger than reported profit in 2024 and positive across three years; reported profit is not a reliable denominator because of impairment and tax effects.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No maintenance/growth split; 2024 purchase of PP&E HK$19.178m and three-year capex history are used as operating reinvestment evidence.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital movements were mixed: inventory released cash but receivables increased and payables decreased; no structural cash drain was evident, but exact normal reinvestment is not separately disclosed.
